figurative_meaning_bn: খুব পরিচ্ছন্ন বা সুসজ্জিত, যেন ধুয়ে-পরিষ্কার করে শক্ত করে রাখা
figurative_meaning_en: extremely clean or neatly dressed, as if starched and ironed to stiffness
example_sentences_in_english: He went to the wedding spick and span.
Keep the house spick and span.
history: Refers to traditional Bengali practice of starching dhotis with rice starch (পাট) for crispness, common in rural laundering customs.
note: The idiom draws from the visual of a freshly starched dhoti (পাটভাঙা ধুতি), symbolizing meticulous care in appearance.
